blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of locally hand crafted beers in a cozy west-coast themed tasting room. The brewery offers core beers on tap and limited release brews exclusive to the tasting room. The onsite Arrowsmith Smokehouse serves Southern Style BBQ with meats, sandwiches, and pizzas made and smoked in house.
